INSERT INTO downloads (
                provider,
                track_id,
                metadata
            )
            VALUES (?, ?, ?)
            ON CONFLICT(provider, track_id)
            DO UPDATE SET
                metadata = excluded.metadata,
                status = 'pending',
                downloaded_bytes = 0,
                total_bytes = NULL,
                retry_count = 0,
                next_retry_at = NULL,
                path = NULL,
                error_message = NULL,
                finished_at = NULL,
                updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
            WHERE downloads.status = 'cancelled'
            RETURNING id
